description: This file contains profiling and benchmarking functions for RNN models, including command-line interface for parameter configuration, system command execution, and profiling output management.

methods.name: run_rnn
methods.description: Runs a specified RNN model multiple times with given parameters, executing forward and backward passes.

methods.name: profile
methods.description: Profiles a list of RNNs by running them with specified parameters, with optional sleep intervals.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its return code, stdout, and stderr.

methods.name: describe_sizes
methods.description: Formats RNN size parameters into a string label.

methods.name: nvprof_output_filename
methods.description: Generates a filename for NVProf output based on RNN types, sizes, and current date.

methods.name: nvprof
methods.description: Runs NVProf profiling on a command, saving output to specified path.

methods.name: full_profile
methods.description: Constructs and executes a full profiling command for specified RNNs and parameters, using NVProf.
